event_chain.summary: 3.4 GB claimed stolen from isolated file transfer system

summary: Sedgwick confirmed a cybersecurity incident affecting an isolated file transfer system at its federal contractor subsidiary, Sedgwick Government Solutions, after the TridentLocker ransomware group claimed on December 31, 2025 to have stolen 3.4 GB of data. The subsidiary handles claims and risk management for U.S. federal agencies including DHS, ICE, CBP, USCIS, DOL and CISA. Sedgwick said the unit is segmented from the rest of the company and its ability to serve clients was not affected.
